questions.question: Which offices will miss their goal, and by how much?

args.sql: SELECT office, goal_total - doors_to_date AS shortfall FROM v_office_pace WHERE goal_total > doors_to_date AND goal_total - doors_to_date > 0 AND goal_total - doors_to_date > overtime_threshold_hours * 4;

sources.text: The overtime threshold is 40 paid hours in a payroll week, Monday through Sunday, counting every shift the person worked. Hours over 40 are paid at 1.5 times the hourly rate. Any shift that takes a person over 40 hours needs the field director's approval and stays pending until it is approved.

The client daily report counts attempts, pulled at the end of each day before any QC rollback. Our dashboard counts doors with rollbacks removed. The gap on any day is the repeat attempts at the same door plus any attempts that were later rolled back. A normal day shows a gap of a few percent from repeat attempts. A larger gap almost always means a rollback.
